v.rule.text: Write the ordinary Tuesday they've already lived.

v.l1.text: Coffee before the inbox, a conversation before the meetings, and work that feels a little less like work.

v.l2.text: Not a day off, just ninety minutes that changes the rest of the afternoon.

v.l3.text: The game is on, dinner arrives, and someone always stays a little longer than they planned.

v.l4.text: Somewhere you never need an occasion to come in, only a reason to stay.
